long_biography.plain_text:
Mahlon Kerr grew up in a family of doctors and knew early that he wanted to practise surgery. After biology studies at the University of Oregon, he trained at Oregon Health & Science University, finding a plastic-surgery mentor who brought him into the operating room. An internship in Nevada and reconstructive residency in Utah gave him a broad clinical foundation.

Kerr established a practice in Round Rock and developed particular expertise in breast enhancement and reconstructive techniques. He has pursued research into fat grafting and breast reconstruction, and teaches medical students and residents in Texas. His volunteer work has taken him to Latin America to operate and train others in cleft lip and palate surgery.
